**Description**
 Job Summary:
   

  

 PowerSecure is seeking a passionate software engineer for our Software Development team. The software engineer will be part of a team that is focused on delivering quality and maintainable code that enables growth of current and future products and services to our customers. Program in multiple languages to create specified products. Document code, including commenting and reporting on features. Work across teams to identify and solve problems. Interpret requirements and create project plans to meet schedule and quality goals.
   

  

 Minimum Qualifications: (Education, Experience, Knowledge, and Skills):
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or engineering.
* 2 \+ years of software development.
* Experience building web applications and familiar with AngularJS, HTML and CSS.
* Proficiency in TypeScript and Python.
* Experience designing and integrating RESTful APIs.
* Experience with databases such as SQL, Amazon RDS and DynamoDB.
* Excellent debugging and optimization skills.
* Unit/integration testing experience preferred.
* Experience with cloud technologies preferably AWS.
* Knowledge of serverless framework preferred.
* Excellent work ethic, ability to work and travel independently, and advanced strategic thinking skills.
* Expert level communication, interpersonal, and critical thinking skills. Expert level troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to influence and work as part of a cross\-functional team.
* Detail\-oriented, can identify and fix own bugs, and write quality code that runs efficiently.
* Passionate, positive, can\-do attitude and can adapt to any challenge and willing to take ownership of problems and brings issues to full resolution.
* Enjoy working in a collaborative team environment.


**Job Duties And Responsibilities**
* Develop new features and infrastructure development in support of rapidly emerging business and project requirements.
* Ensure application performance, uptime, and scale, maintaining high standards of code quality and thoughtful application design.
* Work with agile development methodologies, adhering to best practices and pursuing continued learning opportunities.
* Validate requirements and designs for custom built software projects.
* Work across teams to define, drive, and facilitate the creation and adoption of platform architecture and standards.
* Engage with designers and front\-end engineers, and collaborate with back\-end engineers as we create reliable APIs. Physical Demands and Work Environment:
* Primarily remote with minimum travel.
* The primary office is located in Durham, NC.
* Collaborate via MS Teams, GitHub comments and documents.
